output.reason: The bug is that when the exponential self-heal backoff delay exceeds the cap (`controller.self.heal.backoff.cap.seconds`), the controller uses the previously calculated delay instead of the cap [ev-37aaf197103c][ev-40fea6ee954f][ev-b07db6984567]. No evidence mentions a `--self-heal` CLI flag. Using `gvk-in-use` on Application would flag every Argo CD environment, so the proposed condition is both unsupported and far too broad. Exposure depends on whether self-heal attempts repeat at runtime until the computed delay passes the cap, which no static configuration shows.

correction.statement: Bug fix in the application controller: when the exponential self-heal backoff delay exceeds controller.self.heal.backoff.cap.seconds, the delay is now capped at that maximum instead of the previously calculated delay. Exposure depends on runtime self-heal retry behaviour.

exposure.needed: whether self-healing applications go through enough consecutive self-heal attempts at runtime that the computed backoff delay exceeds controller.self.heal.backoff.cap.seconds
